label: Representation Shift
description: Bijective or isomorphic transformation of mathematical problem space to expose latent structure.
preconditions: Coordinate or domain bijection or embedding exists
omitted_information: Canonical coordinate artifacts of original domain

label: Auxiliary Construction
description: Introduction of an auxiliary mathematical object (scalar field, functional, co-vector, kernel) to certify or mediate solution properties.
preconditions: Primary equations define well-posed action on target space
preserved_invariants: Underlying state dynamics and boundary conditions
introduced_structures: Auxiliary scalar, functional, kernel, or co-vector
omitted_information: Direct brute-force evaluation of primary trajectory

label: Admissibility Constraining
description: Restricting problem search space to physically or mathematically admissible regularized function classes.
preconditions: Admissibility functional or boundary constraint well-defined
preserved_invariants: Physical feasibility and regularity of solutions
introduced_structures: Admissibility set boundary / Sobolev regularity class

label: Invariant Reasoning
description: Deducing asymptotic or structural properties from conserved, monotone, or invariant quantities.
preconditions: Candidate conserved, monotone, or invariant quantity exists
preserved_invariants: Global orbit boundedness, energy conservation, or topology
introduced_structures: Invariant algebraic certificate or Lyapunov level set

label: Negative Information Directive
description: Explicit formal declaration of degrees of freedom, trajectory paths, or operations that need not be calculated.
preconditions: Target objective does not require discarded degrees of freedom
preserved_invariants: Information essential for answer to target question Q
introduced_structures: Explicit negative boundary directive (what NOT to compute)

label: Global Reasoning
description: Constructing uniform global bounds or envelopes across entire parameter domains rather than local approximations.
preconditions: Domain is bounded or uniform envelope exists
preserved_invariants: Worst-case bounds across entire parameter domain
introduced_structures: Minimax deviation envelope or global bound

label: Local Reasoning
description: Analyzing local differential structure, Riemannian tangent spaces, or infinitesimal increments.
preconditions: Local differential or manifold structure exists
preserved_invariants: Tangent bundle dynamics and infinitesimal consistency
introduced_structures: Local tangent velocity or differential form

label: Forward Causal Reasoning
description: Deterministic causal propagation from known initial conditions and operators.
preconditions: Evolution operator generator exists and generates semigroup
preserved_invariants: Causality and forward deterministic state flow

label: Inverse Spectral/Boundary Reasoning
description: Reconstructing hidden internal operators or coefficients from external boundary or spectral data.
preconditions: Forward map is known and measurement data is provided
preserved_invariants: Data consistency and spectral identity relations
introduced_structures: Inverse reconstruction map or integral kernel

label: Direct Closed Solution
description: Evaluation of explicit closed-form analytic formulas or exact resolvent operators.
preconditions: Closed-form or non-iterative operator resolvent exists

label: Indirect Qualitative Inference
description: Deducing qualitative truth values (stability, existence, uniqueness) without calculating exact numeric trajectories.
preconditions: Sufficient qualitative ordering or certificate theorem holds

label: State Dimensionality Reduction
description: Projection or moment-aggregation of high-dimensional state vectors to lower-dimensional macro-variables.
preconditions: Retained variables are sufficient for target question Q

label: State Augmentation & Dual Co-States
description: Lifting a constrained optimization into an augmented phase space with Lagrange multipliers or co-state vectors.
preconditions: Differentiable structure on state transition dynamics
omitted_information: Non-smooth path space variations in primal space

label: Control Action Intervention
description: Active policy synthesis guiding dynamical evolution within admissible actuator bounds.
preconditions: Actuator set and control admissibility set specified
introduced_structures: Feedback control law or switching function

label: Extremal Point Stationarity
description: Characterizing optimal configurations by stationarity, sign-switching, or minimax alternation conditions.
preconditions: Target functional possesses supremum/infimum or stationary points
preserved_invariants: Optimality conditions and necessary boundary relations

label: Self-Consistent Field Closure
description: Closing an infinite multi-particle hierarchy by coupling distribution dynamics to the self-induced collective field.
preserved_invariants: Conservation of total mass/charge/momentum in closed loop
introduced_structures: Self-consistent mean field equation or moment closure
omitted_information: Infinite hierarchy of higher-order multi-particle correlations
